subhypotheses.claim: The single-junction detailed-balance benchmark is conditional rather than universal.
Spectral partitioning and thermal recovery are plausible architecture routes worth testing.
A hybrid claim requires a common energy/accounting boundary.
Stability and transfer must gate claimed applicability.

prohibited_inferences: Do not convert a component efficiency into a system net efficiency.
Do not report a discovered review as a new measured performance result.
Do not state or imply that the proposal violates thermodynamics or energy conservation.
Do not claim deployed performance from a laboratory-source condition.
